name: Navalagamella (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, red above and purple below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navalagamella (a cow on green and a bridge on red).
history: Municipal flag of Navalagamella; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Navalagamella arms — cow on green and bridge on red
